title: [DEV] AAPSclient misses downloads
body:
AAPS 3.2.0.2-dev 2023.11.13 NSClientV3 + websockets
NS dev v15.0.3 5b440b7

Issue similar to #2748 #2932 #3006
Data is in NS, but won't download. Missing data won't backfill, even if I force close AAPSclient, delete cache and restart NSClient. Full sync would surely solve the problem.
